title: HtmlButton
responsibility: Renders the native button element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlButton.attributes
inputs.description: Native button attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlButton.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native button element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlButton
outputs.description: The actual native button element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
